svg.title: Well-Architected Framework
svg.desc: Well-Architected Framework. Review a workload against six pillars, from operational excellence to sustainability, and decide on the trade-offs between them. Step 1, Risks found by surprise: Before any review: risks surface as an outage, an audit and a bill, and each team fixes its part. Step 2, Six pillars, one workload: The review asks each pillar's questions: an old access key and a one-AZ database are high risks. Step 3, From review to milestone: The WA Tool turns the risks into a plan with owners; six months on, high risks are down from 7 to 2. Step 4, Trade-offs and limits: Pillars pull apart: a reader buys failover for $201 a month; record the choice and know the limits.

g.text: Before any review: risks surface as an outage, an audit and a bill, and each team fixes its part.

Pillars pull apart: a reader buys failover for $201 a month; record the choice and know the limits.
